description: Fetch a prompt's full definition, active version, and version history. Use this before updating, publishing, rendering, or copying a prompt when you need the stored template and metadata. template_format in the result shows whether the stored template is a plain string or a JSON messages array.

prompt_id.description: Prompt ID or slug to retrieve

name: get_prompt

data.description: Structured success payload when ok is true

error.description: Structured error payload when ok is false

ok.description: Whether the tool call succeeded and returned structured data
